Allegato: 1 immagine

While working on v1.3 of my AI editor, I discovered a dangerous pitfall: passive self-confirmation. Blindly following feedback from Leo AI and Duck.ai, I degraded the prompt's quality. The paradox? The AI itself recognized the "old" version was better. A hard lesson on active supervision: don't delegate critical thinking. 🤖🔙

https://noblogo.org/itsmelarry-en/how-i-almost-ruined-my-ai-project-by-trusting-feedback-too-much-and-how-i
